title.zh-TW: 吃喝最高 10% 現金回饋
title.en: Up to 10% cash back on food and drink

text.zh-TW: 另有不定期加碼活動。 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Bonus offers also appear from time to time. From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link.

steps.zh-TW: 完成 Ocard 會員註冊。
依活動規則領取並使用回饋。
steps.en: Claim and use the rewards under the campaign rules.

intro.zh-TW: 成為 Ocard 會員，吃吃喝喝就能享最高 10% 現金回饋，還有不定期加碼。
intro.en: Become an Ocard member and earn up to 10% cash back on food and drink, plus occasional bonus offers.

description.zh-TW: Ocard 是提供會員回饋的服務，成為會員後，吃吃喝喝最高可享 10% 現金回饋，另有不定期加碼活動。本頁的邀請連結已包含推薦碼 6qEWW4，使用連結註冊即可。完成 Ocard 會員註冊後，依活動規則領取並使用回饋；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
description.en: Ocard is a membership service: as a member you can earn up to 10% cash back on food and drink, with bonus offers appearing from time to time. The invite link on this page already contains referral code 6qEWW4, so signing up through it is enough. After you complete the Ocard registration, you claim and use the rewards under the campaign rules, and actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 推薦碼 6qEWW4 已包含在連結中，使用連結註冊即可。
notes.en: Referral code 6qEWW4 is already part of the link; just sign up through it.
